messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT triggered: PROMETHEUS_SCRAPE_FAILURE for cluster=redwood-prod — 4/7 targets DOWN, scrape_errors increasing since 14:02 UTC. Automated page sent to on-call.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-8432 created -> urgency: high. Notifying schedule: sre-oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-8432
maria: got page, acking and jumping in. starting checklist.
kevin: on my way, will join if needed. ping me with current blast radius.
maria: quick check: grafana panels show scrape_errors spike at 14:01 and target_downs on prometheus-exporter pods. logs show 503 from exporter on node-gpu-2.
ashley: saw ingestion lag in logs pipeline dashboards too — ingestion-lag metric up from ~30s to ~6m for log-shipper-1. Possible correlation.
ted: assigning roles: maria troubleshooting prometheus targets, kevin looking at exporter's pod metrics & kube events, ashley checking log pipeline and downstream backpressure.
ops-bot: /aws-alarms: SQS-queue-depth increased to 120k for logs-ingest-queue (threshold 10k)
maria: running quick curl to prometheus targets API to confirm status:
```
curl -sS 'http://prometheus.redwood.svc:9090/api/v1/targets?state=down' | jq '.data.activeTargets[] | {labels:.labels, scrapePool:.scrapePool, lastError:.lastError}'
```
maria: output shows exporter on node-gpu-2 failing TLS handshake with backend, lastError: "read tcp 10.2.3.4:443: connection reset by peer"
kevin: checking kube events:
```
kubectl -n monitoring get pods -o wide | grep exporter
kubectl -n monitoring describe pod prometheus-exporter-node-gpu-2
```
kevin: node-gpu-2 had an iptables/netfilter error, docker overlay flapping earlier. kubelet restarted exporter twice.
ashley: logs-ingest backlog likely from prometheus scraping backlog causing backpressure on fluentd aggregation -> SQS pileup. customers hitting delayed metrics and logs for dashboards.
maria: mitigation plan: 1) remove node-gpu-2 exporter from scrape targets (blacklist) 2) scale exporter to a new node pool 3) increase scraping timeout temporarily. Doing step 1 now.

maria: updating prometheus scrape config to drop that target and reloading Prometheus via API:
```
# patch dynamic_sd or relabel config
curl -XPOST http://prometheus.redwood.svc:9090/-/reload
```
maria: reload succeeded. monitoring shows target removed from active list. scrape_errors dropping.
kevin: spun up replacement exporter on node-gpu-5 and cordoned node-gpu-2 for investigation.
ashley: scaled log-shipper deployment from 3 -> 6 to drain backlog and reduce SQS pressure. Watching SQS depth.
ops-bot: SQS-queue-depth: 120k -> 65k (after scale)
ashley: confirming downstream consumer (log-indexer) is catching up, error rates for indexing dropped from 12% -> 3%.
kevin: note: exporter container image had recent bump to 1.4.2 with an TLS handshake change. pinning to 1.4.1 on affected nodes until we validate.
maria: customer impact assessment: dashboards delayed for ~22min window (14:01–14:23 UTC). Affected: metrics for ~12 customers using high-cardinality exporters; some internal jobs retried -> increased cost. No data loss observed; backlog being processed.
ashley: putting a message in #support to warn users about delayed metrics/ingestion and reference to incident PD-8432 once I have the incident summary.
kevin: handoff: @maria I'm off for a call in 8, @kevin taking over post-call. I'll leave TODOs: run full exporter image audit, validate overlay network on node-gpu-2, open infra ticket.
maria: ack handoff, thanks. @kevin you're primary. tagging eng-rt for exporter's image rollback if needed: @ashley FYI.
kevin: running a quick grep for similar TLS resets in node logs; adding a bailiff check to the nodes playbook.

maria: monitoring: prometheus errors stable, log pipeline backlog dropped to 10k, target_down count at 0. Ops metrics returning to baseline.
ops-bot: Incident PD-8432: status -> acknowledged -> mitigated. Notifying PagerDuty to close if no regressions in 20m.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-8432 status updated: acknowledged -> resolved (manual close pending validation).
ashley: posting short incident note to #incidents and starting a postmortem draft. Action items: (1) exporter image rollback validation (owner: kevin), (2) improve exporter healthchecks (owner: maria), (3) add alert for SQS queue growth faster (owner: ashley).
kevin: leaving final note: PR already opened to pin exporter to 1.4.1 in daemonset, will follow up with image rollout plan.
maria: closing thread: good catch, good coordination. will follow up in postmortem. :thumbsup:
